newsitem.title: RUSSIA: LUKoil shares to trade on MICEX.
newsitem.headline: LUKoil shares to trade on MICEX.

text.p: Shares in Russia's largest oil producer LUKoil are now listed on the Moscow Interbank Currency Exchange (MICEX), MICEX chief executive Alexander Zakharov said on Wednesday.
Zakharov told a news conference the MICEX council had decided to include shares in OAO Neftyanaya Kompaniya LUKoil on the listing at a meeting on April 9.

The MICEX is seeking a new role as its share of the tightly regulated currency market dwindles. It is the official floor for the large and transparent government securities market, but has recently branched out into equities.
Shares in regional utility Mosenergo MSNG.RTS, mining concern Norilsk Nickel NKEL.RTS and long-distance phone operator Rostelekom RTKM.RTS are currently traded on the MICEX.
A total 104 organisations trade equities on MICEX.
